visualReview.finding: No new static layout defect observed in these final captures: dialog captions and buttons fit, while long notices and details use their scrollable controls.
visualReview.priorIndependentReview: Five normal captures from earlier exact candidate recheck were independently reviewed; final archive audit confirms the native executable, bridge and UI source are unchanged. Final successful queue status is established by stored records and output checks, not by the selected row in a completed-state screenshot.
limits: Hosted 96-DPI Windows Server 2022 display only.
No claim of physical trackpad, high-DPI, multi-monitor, institutional endpoint approval or human tester acceptance.
Static capture review does not establish absence of every transient rendering issue.

receiptFailureFinding.deterministicWindowsPrimitive: An external READ/WRITE/DELETE-sharing handle caused the exact private runtime os.replace to fail with WinError5; closing the reader allowed the same staged replacement to succeed with both old and staged bytes retained.
receiptFailureFinding.implementation: Only queue and run-history atomic replacements retry Windows errors5/32/33 for eight bounded waits totaling550ms; no deletion/copy fallback or re-execution.
receiptFailureFinding.finalExactPackageProof: The added ninth host check exercises real short queue/history handles and a persistent queue handle against the unchanged final packaged host. Both ordinary and spaced path cases passed.
receiptFailureFinding.historicalLimit: Earlier incomplete captures do not independently establish the precise cause of every historical intermittent failure; those failures remain retained rather than retrospectively reclassified as passes.

limits: Synthetic known-answer fixtures and bounded cancellation/storage experiments, not realistic-data capacity or Windows-versus-Linux benchmarks.
